references.text: Pagiel son of Ocran is first mentioned here as the leader of the tribe of Asher during the census in the wilderness.
Pagiel son of Ocran is named as the chief over the tribe of Asher in the camp arrangement.
Pagiel son of Ocran led the army of Asher when the Israelites broke camp from Sinai.
Asher was one of Jacob's sons, born to Zilpah, and became the ancestor of the tribe of Asher which Pagiel represented.
